_note: A runes component without slots is a plain Svelte 5 Component (callable only; new is TS2554/TS7009) unless its event map has an entry. A declared $$Events counts only the events it names, as upstream's extractEvents reads them: property signatures of an interface, of a type-literal alias, or of the literal members of an intersection alias. type $$Events = Base and an empty interface name none, so those components stay function components; an interface with a member or an intersection with a literal member makes the component isomorphic (new works). Verified against upstream svelte-check --tsgo with svelte 5.55.
